workflow.name: 退款GMV/PMV统计-按赞内赞外
workflow.description: 统计指定月份、指定类型（赞内/赞外）的退款GMV和退款PMV，按线上/线下分组
workflow.business_scenario: 需要分析某个月份的退款情况，区分赞内/赞外、线上/线下

step.name: 查询退款GMV/PMV
step.description: 从聚合表直接查询退款数据
step.sql_template:
SELECT
  pay_month,
  offline_tag_final,
  SUM(gmv_refund_amount) / 100 AS gmv_refund_amount_yuan,
  SUM(pmv_refund_amount) / 100 AS pmv_refund_amount_yuan
FROM dev.pay_gmv_26_items_1209
WHERE gmv_type = '{{gmv_type}}'
  AND pay_month = '{{pay_month}}'
GROUP BY pay_month, offline_tag_final
LIMIT 1000

key_concepts.offline_tag_final: 线上线下分类，枚举值：线上、线下
